candidate: strict generic binary relation surface relation(quoted_relation_id,lhs,rhs) plus typed RelationId semantic resolver

execution_surface.reason: E2B is repository-marked runtime-verified but is not exposed as an invokable tool on this ChatGPT surface. Prior independent E2B replication of the parent grammar defect was consumed as existing evidence, not counted as fresh replication of this candidate.

semantic_property_tested: Binary relation identity and operand order remain explicit and hash-sensitive while relation vocabulary is removed from lexer/operator classification; parser acceptance alone does not admit semantic relation identity because a separate typed resolver fails closed on unknown RelationIds.

concurrent_counterevidence_consumed.finding: A finite declared infix relation resolver also passed its tested known forms and rejected 50000/50000 unknown relation words; therefore this run does not establish that generic canonical syntax is superior to declared readable infix syntax.
concurrent_counterevidence_consumed.synthesis: Both candidates converge on the same deeper requirement: typed semantic relation resolution must be separate from lexer acceptance. The remaining question is surface policy and migration/reader/compiler cost.

not_proven: roundtrip of every G9 statement form
counterhypothesis: A declared infix relation registry can lower to the same typed canonical Relation IR with lower reader/migration cost, making generic syntax useful only as canonical/generic serialization rather than the sole surface.
falsifier_next_test: Implement both generic quoted relation form and declared-infix-registry form over one shared typed RelationId resolver in the real BASE parser; run complete admitted G9+dialect corpus, roundtrip, unknown-symbol mutation/fuzz, diagnostics, migration-edit count and target-reader/token benchmarks.
